# FLUX

> LLM cost reduction for Claude (Anthropic), OpenAI and OpenAI-compatible
> APIs, billed as a percentage of verified savings. Integration is one URL
> (proxy mode) or one line (SDK). Savings are measured per completed task
> with quality held, from the provider's own reported usage, and every
> invoice is recomputable by the customer from a hash-chained event ledger.
> Figures are per traffic segment (one number would be wrong for most
> customers), simulator-measured at providers' published prices: multi-turn
> Claude cache-only 37.6% vs the same prompt-reduction stack without caching
> (both arms clean 38/40); the 57.1% full-stack comparison loses 5 pp clean
> tasks against raw uncached baseline and fails the -2 pp quality limit, so it
> is not a qualified win. Other figures: async/batch 57.7% net, one-shot templated 45.5-72.8%,
> interactive agents 25.9-34.0%, already-optimised stacks 0-5% with an
> explicit do-not-pay-us verdict. The fee is 15% of verified savings,
> monthly, nothing else; a month that saved nothing bills nothing. The latest real-traffic export (30 requests on
> claude-sonnet-5-5) measured 18.0% of live spend billed as verified savings
> across five agents, with the Claude cache lever earning live.
